auxiliary: AuxEngine ce burial-only: + 1.0 x burial cross-entropy vs soft target 1 - clip(RSA, 0, 1), PINDER free branch and pKPDB train_mask sites; one-logit head aux_burial on the final site embedding (pkatrain.production_aux)
dihedrals: production_inputs.backbone_dihedrals: sin/cos phi, psi, omega from backbone-v1 appended to the node features (6); embedding +6 rows
drop_bonded_cys: training pKa loss excludes Cys queries whose SG is within 2.3 A of another SG (sidechains-v1, bound structure; PINDER AB and free together); validation unchanged (production_gate)
dropout: oGQT residual dropout 0.1 on attention and feed-forward outputs during training (DropoutEngine); one key per complex shared by its AB and free branches

hotspot_mask.augmentation: hotspot-mask-v2: per visit (own stream [MASK2_SALT, crc32(id), visit]) masked with probability prob, else identity mask (every residue kept); sides one: the v1 rule on one chain drawn uniformly, the other chain fully unmasked; mask_side -1 / 0 / 1 / 2 (history pinder_mask_visit_fraction, pinder_mask_side_fraction = chain-1 share of one-sided visits)
hotspot_mask.definition: third pass on the free branch with the residue-type one-hot zeroed on every residue outside the unmasked set: per chain the top round(keep x surface) surface residues (free RSA >= 0.1) by the oracle (NaN lowest, ties by a random draw; random: uniform), plus round(soft x rest) of the remaining surface residues at random; buried residues always masked (no interface chemistry). Edge BCE free part + free -> bound distillation and the within listwise loss on the masked pass; bound BCE, Siamese burial, gate, pKa unchanged (production_residue.hotspot_keep / mask_nodes; replaces the re-typed pass)
hotspot_mask.fallback: complex without a store record -> random oracle for that visit (counted: history pinder_mask_fallbacks)

objective: gqt_multitask_replay.JointEngine: pKPDB state-shift MSE (train_mask) + PINDER AB/free state-shift MSE + binding-shift MSE; equal coefficients; no site weights
optimizer: AdamW weight decay 1e-4, global clip 1 after gradient summation

orientation.definition: production_inputs: residue edges + direction to i in j's frame, F_i^T F_j, signed sequence separation / 32 (13 features) from backbone-v1; residue and query block edge projections 20 -> 33

residue_burial: PINDER burial on every residue token of the free branch vs 1 - clip(rsa_free) (residue-rsa-v1), replacing the query-site term; pKPDB unchanged (production_residue)
residue_burial_siamese: burial on both PINDER branches, every residue, bound vs 1 - clip(RSA_bound), free vs 1 - clip(RSA_free) (cross-entropy, averaged), + squared error of sigmoid(bound) - sigmoid(free) vs clip(RSA_free) - clip(RSA_bound) (residue-rsa-v1); pKPDB unchanged

residue_edges.definition: aux_redge symmetric pair scorer on normalised residue tokens; (free + bound) / 2 + Siamese distillation; soft target min(1, exp(-(d - 4) / 3)) <= 10 A (production_residue)

sampling: full PINDER fraction per epoch; one pKPDB batch per PINDER batch from a continuing shuffled stream
schedule: stretched_learning_rate x 1.4142 (1e-3 hold to epoch 20, cosine to 1e-5 by epoch 40); patience 16, min delta 0.001
selection: min PINDER validation state MAE + interface paired MAE

titratable_gate.definition: aux_gate logit on every all-residue token (side chain / N-terminus / C-terminus); BCE vs D/E/H/C/Y/K/R minus bonded Cys (per branch; free = same chain), node columns 20 / 21; per-structure weighted mean, PINDER branches averaged (production_gate)

within_listwise.definition: free branch; anchors = interface residues (surface, a cross-chain partner <= 10 A) of both chains; candidates = interface residues of the other chain, all contacts (soft target min(1, exp(-(d - 4) / 3))) + non-contacts (target 0); softmax cross-entropy vs normalised target, mean over valid anchors per complex, then over complexes (production_residue.within_sample / within_loss)
within_listwise.target_definition: drsa-within-v1: contact target soft(d_ac) * min(dRSA_a, dRSA_c), dRSA = clip(RSA_free - RSA_bound, 0, 1) (residue-rsa-v1, NaN -> 0); non-contacts 0; anchors with summed target < 1e-6 dropped (valid 0; counted in history loader_counts.within); anchor eligibility and candidate sampling distance-defined, same draws as distance mode
